name: Ubooquity
tagline: A free, lightweight and easy-to-use home server for your comics and ebooks. Use it to access your files from anywhere, with a tablet, an e-reader, a phone or a computer.
description: Ubooquity is a free, lightweight and easy-to-use home server for your comics and ebooks. Use it to access your files from anywhere, with a tablet, an e-reader, a phone or a computer.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/ubooquity:3.1.0@sha256:e484ecb4aa66fd0bde885850f48c8818ee7c7cd9cdb8cd3b279a98b0fb6ec7e0
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
      MAXMEM: ''
    ports:
      - target: 2202
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 2203
        published: 2203
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/books
        target: /books
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/comics
        target: /comics
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/files
        target: /files
